title: Technology Sector Update for 01/03/2019: RESN,IZEA,AAPL
text:

Technology stocks were sharply lower following Apple's ( AAPL ) surprise sales warning. At last look, the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 were losing over 4% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling 5.3%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Resonant ( RESN ) was down 5.3% Thursday afternoon, giving back an early 4% advance after the maker of radio frequency front-end filters for the mobile device industry reporting four new license agreements with its largest "Tier 1" customer.
In other sector news:
(+) IZEA Worldwide ( IZEA ) jumped over 32% higher at one point on Thursday after the ecommerce platform connecting marketers and content creators said it won multiple contracts during December.
(-) Apple ( AAPL ) dropped 9% after the technology giant late Wednesday slashed its fiscal Q1 revenue forecast, blaming fewer iPhone upgrades than anticipated in China and other markets. It now expects around $84 billion in sales for the three months ended Dec. 30, lagging the Capital IQ consensus.
